subject: Action items & trial setup: ClearWave discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Connor Mills <connor@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Action items & trial setup: ClearWave discovery follow-up

Hi Connor —

Thanks again for the 45-minute call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before we start the trial: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: high latency and inconsistent throughput on batch inference for multi-tenant analytics queries; monthly costs spiking during end-of-month reporting windows.
- Goal: reduce average per-request latency from ~420ms to under 120ms for the 95th percentile and cut per-token inference cost by 40% on weekly batch runs.

Proposed trial scope (30 days)
- Workload: 3 representative pipelines (ad-hoc analytics, scheduled nightly ETL, and live dashboard refresh).
- Models: run your current LlamaX-13B fp16 baseline and a Redwood-recommended int8-quant variant for comparison.
- Success metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, and accuracy delta on 3 conserved eval prompts (goal: <= 3% regression).

Prompt sets & evals
- Attached: sample_prompts.csv (3 prompt families + expected rubric). We'll run automated evals daily and share results in the dashboard.

Owners & timeline
- ClearWave: Connor (primary), Priya (data access) — provide sample data and schema.
- Redwood: Soojin (eng lead contact), Karthik (infra/config), Vanessa (observability & evals).
- Timeline: Week 0 — access + infra prep; Week 1 — baseline runs; Week 2 — quant/compare; Week 3 — optimizations; Week 4 — wrap + results.

Access & setup checklist (needed from ClearWave)
- Short-term VPN access or SSH bastion + hostname allowlist
- S3 read-only bucket with sample data or short-lived signed URL (5–10GB)
- Service account with list of scopes for logs/metrics ingestion
- PO number or signed SOW (we can start with trial credit if procurement is delayed)

Attachments
- POC_Scope_v1.pdf — scope + acceptance criteria (attached)
- network_diagram.png — suggested network flow for Redwood Private VPC peering (attached)
- sample_prompts.csv — sample prompts and eval rubric (attached)

Next steps (actionable)
1) Connor: confirm the 30-day window and whether you can provide an S3 signed URL or prefer a temp VPN by EOD Tuesday.
2) Priya: share the data schema and a sample file (anywhere between 50MB–2GB) by Wednesday.
3) Redwood: we’ll provision trial capacity and send a secure setup checklist + temporary service account by Thursday.

If that plan looks good I’ll open the internal ticket and loop in our infra team to reserve the dedicated pool.

Thanks —

— Soojin Lee
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119
[Attachment: POC_Scope_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]
[Attachment: network_diagram.png (PNG, 180KB)]
[Attachment: sample_prompts.csv (CSV, 8KB)]

Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Action items & trial setup: ClearWave discovery follow-up

Thanks Soojin — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick notes: 

- Timeline: Can we shift the baseline week to start Jan 4 instead of Week 0 this week? Two of our engineers are out until the new year.
- Access: We can produce a signed S3 URL for a 300GB sample set but would prefer not to open a VPN unless necessary. Signed URL should be ready by Wednesday PST.
- PO/SOW: Procurement needs a short SOW + cost estimate. If you can share a one-page SOW and trial credit notice we can get internal approval faster.

I’ll confirm Priya will send the schema and a 1–2GB sample by Wednesday. Otherwise we’re good to start Jan 4.

Connor
Head of Product | ClearWave Analytics
connor@clearwave.ai | +1 212-555-0190

Connor / Soojin — thanks for the quick replies. A couple technical clarifications from infra: 

1) Signed S3 URL works for us (we'll stream directly into the Redwood ingestion pipeline and avoid long-lived credentials). Please ensure objects are in few large files rather than many tiny ones — optimal for throughput.

2) Network: if ClearWave later wants Private deployment we’ll request VPC peering and the network_diagram.png in the attachments is our recommended layout. For the trial we do not require peering.

3) Sample data & schema: if you can anonymize PII that speeds approval; otherwise redwood can propose a redaction filter.

4) One-page SOW: I’ve attached a minimal SOW template that outlines trial scope, trial credit, and success criteria. If procurement needs cost numbers we can include an optional committed-cost table.

Action items for Redwood (from our side)- Provision trial pool for Jan 4 start- Send temporary service account (scoped) and secure checklist by Thu 12/30- Create dashboard workspace for ClearWave and add Connor + Priya

— Karthik
Principal Cloud Engineer | Redwood Inference
